verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a hosted and self-hostable search service that stores customer documents and embeddings, so a policy against training on customer data is a fair question to ask. The pack contains no such policy, training opt-out, or statement on how its Cloud service or the third-party embedding providers it calls handle customer data. Self-hosting as a single binary implies data stays on your own infrastructure, but the evidence never ties this to AI training, so it is not credited here.
